result.prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame and strict visual reference. Create a 6-second, 1:1 square video for Instagram feed, audio off, in one continuous shot. PRESERVE the bottle’s exact silhouette and proportions, pale pink glass color, silver nozzle, original placement, photographic style and soft lighting against the unchanged white background. PRESERVE the hanging tag’s shape, attachment, position relative to the bottle, and existing lettering exactly; do not redraw or add text. From 0–4 seconds, the bottle makes one slow, smooth turn on the spot around its vertical axis, rotating only slightly so its familiar front remains visible. The nozzle and attached tag follow naturally as one assembly, without independent spinning or distracting swinging. A soft highlight travels gently across the glass during the turn, revealing its curvature while preserving the pale pink color and consistent background exposure. Make one very slow, subtle camera push-in, keeping the entire bottle and tag comfortably in frame. Ease the rotation and camera to a stop by 4 seconds; hold the final bottle view completely steady for the final two seconds. Check that the first frame matches the reference and the last frame retains the same bottle geometry, nozzle, attachment and readable tag lettering. Negatives: no cuts, extra objects, hands, warped glass, changing liquid level, nozzle deformation, tag flutter, altered lettering, added text, color shifts, background changes, flicker or audio.
